name: blockforge
description: Picture to stud-style 3D model. A local block modeling editor with an AI build pipeline, 3D scan references, MCP tools and Roblox export.
author: zielonyxiom

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of ['server/server.js','server/pipeline.js','server/model.js','server/llm.js','server/images.js','server/mesh3d.js','server/roblox.js','server/batch.js','server/templates.js','server/trees.js','server/analyze.js','server/details.js','server/comfyui3d.js','server/claude.js','server/config.js','server/prompts.js','mcp/mcp-server.js','scripts/install-mcp.mjs','public/app.js','public/mesh.js','public/roblox.js']) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('all files OK')"
